baseline_1_structural_only.description: Rule-based structural limits (amount cap, allowlist). Blind to semantic drift.

baseline_2_intentguard_hybrid.description: Deterministic structural checks + Multi-sample semantic entailment + Confidence scoring.

baseline_3_semantic_only.description: LLM semantic judgment without hard mathematical structural constraints.

key_findings: IntentGuard reduced false-allow rate from 7.0% (Structural-only) to 0.0%.
100% of out-of-scope semantic drift cases (e.g. chocolates under office supplies) intercepted.
All ambiguous context requests safely escalated to human review queue.
